caption_L2L3: The four largest amount of visitors in 2019 are from Russia, Germany, Sweden and Japan. The next most similar amount of visitors are from China, UK and USA. Then the least amount of similar number of visitors are from Denmark, Estonia, France, Italy, Netherlands, Norway, Spain and Switzerland. I notice that the lowest amount of visitors are all European countries, while the rest are a mixture from around the world.
